facts.business: Lokesh Machines Limited designs, develops, and manufactures CNC machines, Special Purpose Machines, auto components, forgings, and indigenous defence systems including small arms and high-precision defence assemblies.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: OFAC Sanctions – Continuing Regulatory Uncertainty and Mitigation; designation on SDN list since 30 Oct 2024 restricted foreign-currency transactions through 31 Mar 2026; delisting process advanced but matter unresolved at year end; assessed recoverability of trade receivables and going concern basis.

key_risks: OFAC SDN designation restricting foreign-currency transactions and access to certain customers (e.g., Mahindra & Mahindra)
Concentration in a small number of automotive OEM customers in Auto Component Division
Continuing regulatory uncertainty and dependence on foreign regulator (OFAC) for delisting outcome
Potential impact on trade receivables recoverability and going concern assessment due to sanctions
facts.related_party_note: No related party transactions in CSR expenditure (contribution to trust controlled by company: NIL). Details of investments made by the Company are given in the financial statements. No loans or guarantees under Section 186 of Companies Act, 2013.
